declaredCellRuntime.blocker: Rosetta 2 is not installed on this darwin-arm64 host, so the x86_64 binary cannot be translated. The control probe `arch -x86_64 /usr/bin/true` fails the same way although that binary carries an x86_64 slice, which isolates the cause to the missing translation layer rather than the acquired runtime.
declaredCellRuntime.remediation: Run the declared cell on a host with Rosetta 2 installed or on an x86_64 host; the URL and verified digest above are reusable as-is.

substituted.reusedFrom: the runtime already pinned in this workspace; no new network request

legacyCell.rationale: The repository pins Node 12.14.1 exactly and enforces it through engines and a check-node-version prebuild step. That cell is the declared legacy environment; it is recorded here as declared and unreachable on this platform rather than silently replaced.

lockState.integrityCaveat: 2902 entries resolve to registry.yarnpkg.com with an integrity hash, mixing legacy sha1 with sha512. Three entries resolve to git tarballs on codeload.github.com (MyCryptoHQ forks of js-md5, js-sha1, and uuid-by-string) and carry no integrity hash at all. Recorded as found; not upgraded, pinned, or replaced.

baseline.declaredDetail: yarn refused the install because the manifest pins Node 12.14.1 exactly and the substituted runtime is 16.20.2. No package was fetched.
baseline.deviationDetail: With the engine check overridden, yarn resolved and linked the committed lockfile in 62.6 seconds (2233 package directories). The build command was then refused by the same engine check. Whether this project builds under Node 16.20.2 remains unknown.
